svg.text: Smoke test: inspect the mower air filter
✓ 1. Turn off the mower and let it cool.
✓ 3. Unscrew the cover and lift it off.
✓ 4. Pull out the air filter carefully.
✓ 5. Inspect the filter for dirt and damage.
✓ 6. Tap loose dust off the filter.
✓ 7. Replace the filter and secure the cover.
FieldKit by NullAI — local recap card (Muse Image unconfigured)
